title: Width bound for the resulting CNF
statement: Let $n$ and $w$ be natural numbers, and let $cs$ be a list of normal-form OR circuits on $n$ variables. Suppose every member of $cs$ is a base OR-clause with pairwise distinct variable indices, and the list defining each such clause has length at most $w$. Then the CNF obtained from the AND-node over $cs$ has width at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of normal-form OR circuits on $n$ variables
Every member of $cs$ is a base OR-clause
Each clause's circuit literals have pairwise distinct variable indices
Each clause's defining literal list has length at most $w$
replaced:
Fix $n \in \bbn$, let $cs$ be a list of normal-form OR circuits on $n$ variables, and
let $w \in \bbn$. Suppose every circuit in $cs$ is an OR-clause on some list of literals
whose variable indices are pairwise distinct and whose length is at most $w$. Form the
normal-form AND circuit that conjoins all the members of $cs$, and convert that circuit
to a CNF formula by turning each OR-clause into a clause (a disjunction of its
literals). Then this CNF formula has width at most $w$; equivalently, each of its
clauses contains at most $w$ literals.
